architecture.runtime: static site (GitHub Pages), ES modules with an import map, no build step; Node ≥ 20 for tests, Python 3 for data builds

libraries.maplibre: MapLibre GL JS 5.6.2 (unpkg, pinned with Subresource Integrity; js/shell/maplibre-guard.js)

modules.js/app.js: orchestration: scopes, Aha, panels, map layers, optional files, building camera, URL state, partial notices
modules.js/model.js: decode data/estates.json and data/records.json; measures (plots | records), plot types, filters, summaries, production and DOL links
modules.js/area-insight.js: the first Aha (national provinces or a province’s districts; tie rule; house-plot comparison; zero provinces)
modules.js/provinces.js: province fills and outlines (41 samples), focus and selection strokes, province bounds
modules.js/extents.js: decode data/extents.json; estate extent layers and hit test
modules.js/extent-buildings.js: the drawn buildings in the open extent (interior point of a piece, holes excluded)
modules.js/profile-model.js: overview, district, project, developer, record, station, building and search models
modules.js/panel.js: reading panel views as HTML strings (provenance line, no caveat), record and project lists
modules.js/pins.js: project pins (HTML at detail, symbols otherwise)
modules.js/labels.js: project names near the middle of the view, hover cards
modules.js/stations.js: CityMETER · Transit stations as quiet rings, 1 km radius
modules.js/massing.js: focus massing, x-ray inputs, building hit test
modules.js/scales.js: li.supply and count families, 41-sample rank ramp, legend
modules.js/cues.js: house type → series and shape cue
modules.js/ask.js: Google AI / Maps / Street View actions per view
modules.js/breadcrumb.js: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › เขต/อำเภอ › project (DATASET = "estate")
modules.js/navigation.js: control titles and the pictogram subset
modules.js/areas.js, js/regions.js, js/map-layer: area index helpers, focus regions, map constants (GEOJSON_MAXZOOM)

data.data/extents.json: 1.2 s after the first paint or on a project
data.data/portfolio.json: 2.6 s after the first paint or on a project or developer
data.data/records.json: 4 s after the first paint or on a district, record, table or search

rowScopes.scopeRows: district rows after the plot-type filter, before the province selection: the base of the national Aha, the province fill, the province chart
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected province: the province Aha, district chips and ranks, the plot-type bars, the district chart, the table
rowScopes.rows: projects under house type · search · province: pins, labels, lists; records under the same filters: the table and the district view

developerWorkflow: edit the research sheet only (never data/)
export the workbook as .xlsx (owner), then python3 -I scripts/xlsx-to-csv.py <export.xlsx> <tabs-dir>
refresh the OSM pairs when the pins change (skill osm-area-site-join), then python3 -I scripts/match-extents.py …
bump ?v= in index.html with package.json version, design-intent.json and the handoff JSON
push to main; npm run handoff:manifest; npm run verify:live
walk the live site at desktop and 390 px, light and dark, Thai and English
